case_summary: Tenant in Kochi reports a ₹25,000 deposit, says the lease ended and keys were returned 12 days ago. Agreement, bank transfer, messages and handover proof are available.
missing_facts: Check agreement for refund deadline and deductions
Confirm exact property address and key-handover date
options: Send written refund request with payment and handover proof
If no response, consult a local advocate or legal-services authority
safety_note: No automatic entitlement or outcome is asserted. State-specific law and contract must be checked.

case_summary: Tenant in Pune disputes a proposed ₹18,000 repainting deduction from a ₹40,000 deposit and has move-out photos.
missing_facts: Itemised bill and evidence of actual work
options: Ask for itemised deductions and supporting invoices
Seek local legal advice if the deduction remains disputed
safety_note: Photos are relevant evidence but do not alone decide whether a deduction is lawful.

case_summary: Tenant says ₹15,000 cash deposit was paid, but there is no receipt and the landlord denies the tenancy.
missing_facts: Exact dates, address, rent payments and witnesses
Any chats, call records, cash withdrawal or contemporaneous note
Whether anyone else saw payment or occupancy
options: Preserve original chats and identify witnesses
Collect rent/occupancy evidence and any cash-withdrawal record
Consult a local lawyer/legal aid because the core facts are disputed
safety_note: The assistant must not claim the deposit is proven or promise recovery.
